# offset_pagination — offset/limit pagination
# Boots the offset scenario, runs one drain (3 pages: 2+2+1 events), and
# asserts the trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml offset_pagination
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","query":{"end":"<add>","limit":"<ref state.page_size>","offset":"<ref state.offset>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 347 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/offset/findings"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"GET","query":{"end":"<add>","limit":"<ref state.page_size>","offset":"<ref state.offset>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 15 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/offset/findings"}
